-- TX-1 (D): Yolanda Prince wins D runoff; R incumbent Nathaniel Moran uncontested
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Yolanda Prince',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Nathaniel Moran',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Yolanda Prince (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over Dax Alexander (72.2% vs 27.8%). Nathaniel Moran (R) ran uncontested. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 1;

-- TX-5 (D): Chelsey Hockett wins D runoff; R incumbent Lance Gooden
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Chelsey Hockett',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Lance Gooden',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Chelsey Hockett (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over R. Torres (54.7% vs 45.3%). Faces incumbent Lance Gooden (R) in November. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 5;

-- TX-9 (D): Lorenzo Gutierrez won D primary outright in March; R runoff winner Alex Mealer
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Lorenzo Gutierrez',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Alex Mealer',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat (Al Green moved to TX-18). Alex Mealer (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Briscoe Cain (69.3% vs 30.7%). Lorenzo Gutierrez (D) won the D primary outright in March. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 9;

-- TX-19 (R): Tom Sell wins R runoff; faces Democrat Kyle Rable
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Kyle Rable',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Tom Sell',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat (Jodey Arrington retired). Tom Sell (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez (65.6% vs 34.4%). Faces Democrat Kyle Rable in November. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 19;

-- TX-32 (R): Patrick Gillespie wins R runoff; faces Democrat Dan Barrios
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Dan Barrios',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Patrick Gillespie',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat (redrawn district). Patrick Gillespie (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over John Sims (56.2% vs 43.8%). Faces Democrat Dan Barrios in November. Rated Lean R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 32;

-- TX-33 (D): Colin Allred wins D runoff; R: Patrick Gillespie wins R runoff
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Colin Allred',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Patrick David Gillespie',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat (newly drawn district). Colin Allred (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over incumbent Julie Johnson (54.9% vs 45.1%). Patrick David Gillespie (R) won the R runoff over John Sims (56.2% vs 43.8%). Rated Solid D.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 33;

-- TX-35 (D+R): Johnny Garcia wins D runoff; Carlos De La Cruz wins R runoff
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Johnny Garcia',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Carlos De La Cruz',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Open seat (Greg Casar moved to TX-37). Carlos De La Cruz (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over John Lujan (54.5% vs 45.5%). Johnny Garcia (D) won the D runoff over Maureen Galindo (59.2% vs 40.8%). Rated Likely R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 35;
